text:
### Rate Variation (Fixed Rate Period)  
**Fixed Rate 2-Year:** Fixed for 2 years, then re-fixed
**Fixed Rate 5-Year:** Fixed for 5 years, then re-fixed
**Early Repayment Fee (Fixed Rate):** Typically 1–3% of outstanding balance (if early repayment during fixed period)

raw_entities.name: Fixed Rate 2-Year Mortgage
raw_entities.description: A fixed-rate mortgage product where the interest rate is fixed for a 2-year period, after which the rate is re-fixed. This product protects the customer from interest rate fluctuations during the initial fixed period.
context: Fixed Rate 2-Year: Fixed for 2 years, then re-fixed

raw_entities.name: Fixed Rate 5-Year Mortgage
raw_entities.description: A fixed-rate mortgage product where the interest rate is fixed for a 5-year period, after which the rate is re-fixed. This product provides longer-term rate protection compared to the 2-year variant.
context: Fixed Rate 5-Year: Fixed for 5 years, then re-fixed

raw_entities.name: Early Repayment Fee (Fixed Rate)
raw_entities.description: A penalty fee charged to the customer if they repay the mortgage early during the fixed rate period. The fee is typically calculated as a percentage of the outstanding balance.

properties.trigger_event: Early repayment during fixed rate period

context: Early Repayment Fee (Fixed Rate): Typically 1–3% of outstanding balance (if early repayment during fixed period)

raw_entities.name: Rate Re-fixing Provision
raw_entities.description: A contractual provision that governs the automatic re-fixing of the mortgage interest rate at the end of the initial fixed period. The customer's rate will be re-fixed to a new rate determined by the bank at that time.
